name: Silvara
role: Illusionist, Diplomatic Herbalist, Wife of Kaelrath
title: Silvy
bio: Known as Silvy to those close to her. A gifted illusionist with a talent for herbalism and diplomacy. She smooths over political tensions with charm and carefully cultivated garden remedies.
motivation: Keep peace between noble houses using soft power, and raise Tahlia safely among her kin.
